scope: Declared AI source-format profile, pre-upload limits, and truthful picker/review guidance
limitations: The text-v1 profile must be declared by the integration; this is not automatic server capability discovery.
Arbitrary PDF, DOCX, PPTX, RTF, OCR and audio/video processing still need extraction workers.
Prepared demo media replay and ordinary course attachments retain their existing behavior.
No live SSO, paid provider call, deployment or institution acceptance.
verification_notes: One stale disabled-expression source assertion failed on the first full run. Rendered tests now directly prove that consent and source compatibility prevent generation before credentials or upload. The final full run passed.
